thread:
elena: FYI — customer ACME is pushing for per-tenant signed audit bundles and a concrete validation checklist for SOC2/FedRAMP-like requests. They want a delivery SLA and proof they can validate events end-to-end.
elena: They flagged two asks: 1) include RBAC change events (role/grant/revoke) with identity context, 2) signed export bundles (HMAC or asymm) that auditors can verify.
samir: OK noted. Do we have an existing schema field for 'actor_identity' / 'role_changes'? we currently have generic 'actor' and 'action'.
matt: We have action:role_update but it's sparse. No structured before/after role blobs. Backfill will be messy.
elena: They also want retention metadata per-event (created_at, retained_until) and a bundle manifest for exports.
alice: Product question — will this be a paid add-on or part of Dedicated/Private only? billing matters for SLA.
legal: From contract side: signed bundles + tamper-evidence are table stakes for FedRAMP-ish asks. We need options: signed HMAC with customer-managed KMS or signed with Redwood attest key + notarized claim. Both have different acceptance in contracts.
ops-sre: Delivery mechanism: do customers want a pull endpoint or periodic push to S3/HTTPS? Push simplifies SLA (we push at export time), pull means auth, rate-limits, and more infra.
elena: ACME prefers S3 push to their account with object-level signature + manifest.json.sig.
samir: Proposed plan: schema v2 for audit events adding: event_id, actor_identity{type,id,session}, delta{before,after}, retention_hint, tenant_id, request_id. Also produce export manifest with bundle_id, sequence_range, hmac, signing_key_id.
samir: Example event sample:```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "event_type": "rbac.grant",
  "actor_identity": {"type":"user","id":"U123","session":"s-x"},
  "delta": {"before": null, "after": {"role":"data-viewer"}},
  "created_at": "2026-03-19T21:35:12Z",
  "request_id": "req_9a8b"
}
```
alice: That looks reasonable. Ensure sample doesn't leak PII — session IDs need to be hashed for export unless customer allows raw.
legal: Redaction rules: we need configurable redaction policies per export. For HIPAA customers, PHI must be excluded or tokenized. Add explicit export-time policy flags.
security-bot: [automated] note: KMS-integration checklist updated. PR #412 opened for HMAC signing flow using customer KMS via external key wrap.
auditor-bot: [automated] validation helpers: we'll publish a small reference verifier (python) customers can run to check signatures and manifest integrity.
matt: Ops impact: to support per-tenant signed bundles we need export pipeline changes + storage ACLs. Also retention query to validate "retained_until" before export. Backfill: if we roll schema v2, older events need a migration or be flagged as pre-v2 in manifest.
samir: For backfill approach: option A) real-time migration on read (puller adds synthetic fields, marks source_version=1), B) run a one-off ETL to populate new fields for last N months. ETL cost estimate depends on tokens — likely 2-3 engineer-weeks + infra.
elena: Customer asked about SLA: they want proof-of-delivery within 7 days for initial dataset, then weekly exports. Legal wants 30/60/90 day delivery tiers in contract.
legal: Suggested clause: "Redwood will provide signed audit bundles for requested retention window within 30 days of signed request; expedited delivery (7 days) available under SOW or Premium SLA."
ops-sre: FYI: pushing to customer S3 requires cross-account role + signed manifest; ops will need a runbook and extra monitoring. Also cost for storing temporary export bundle in our account before cross-transfer.
alice: OK scope decision: Implement schema v2, export manifest + signing, S3 push support, redaction options, verifier tool. Backfill for last 90 days as paid option.
samir: Risks: signing keys — prefer customer KMS for ultimate trust. If customer KMS not possible, we use Redwood signing key and include key rotation proofs. Need HSM/KMS integration design.
security-bot: [automated] vulnerability note: signing path must avoid exfil of raw keys in logs. Add KMS call tracing and strict IAM.
matt: Action list: 1) API/schema PR for v2 (owner: samir) ETA 1w, 2) Export pipeline prototype (owner: matt) ETA 2w, 3) KMS HMAC design doc (owner: elena) ETA 1w, 4) Legal export clause draft (owner: legal) ETA 3d, 5) Verifier tool (owner: auditor-bot / infra) ETA 2w, 6) Ops runbook (owner: ops-sre) ETA 2w.
elena: I'll coordinate a customer call after 1st PR lands.
alice: Pricing/packaging to follow once we have cost estimates.
legal: I'll draft the expedited delivery language and redaction requirements for HIPAA.
ops-sre: Note: we need a monitoring alert if export fails for >24h for SLA customers.
samir: Will open a tracking epic and link PRs.
elena: Thanks everyone — feel free to add if I missed anything. :thumbsup:
auditor-bot: [automated] closing note: I'll prepare a sample FedRAMP deliverable checklist showing signed manifest, time-ordered events, tamper-evident chain, and sample verification commands.
